stories.title: The death of ‘hello’: how gen Z – and scammers – put paid to the greeting
stories.summary: The traditional phone greeting “hello,” about 200 years old, is falling out of favour amid changing habits among generation Z and concern about scammers. People answering unidentified numbers are advised to remain silent until they know a human is on the line.

stories.title: How one woman’s Tesla was remotely controlled – and used to harass her – by an abusive ex-partner
stories.summary: Enrico Pucci remotely controlled his former partner’s Tesla and used that access to harass her. The linked report says he could manipulate the electric car’s speed, temperature settings and locks from afar.
